balls.text: chips down the track and he gets a thick  top edge which should have been taken by Sehwag at point, he was probably looking at the sun, the ball drops short of him
full outside off and forces it to Vettori at long-off
squeezes a yorker to the on side
short down the leg side and he swings and misses
pushes it hard down to mid-off and they take the risk with de Villiers's arm, Akhil sends him back and Vinay is nowhere in the picture and the direct hit sends him back
that's a short ball and Akhil waits for it to come onto him before biffing it with power over deep midwicket
same region! Kohli tries to clear long-on but he fails to get it past Dilshan who takes it easily
Sangwan has his revenge! He bowls a low full toss and Boucher makes contact with the bottom half of the bat and sends it down Mishra's throat at long-on
fullish outside and he pushes it hard down the pitch
another length ball is whipped over deep midwicket this time, there were about 20 people trying to get underneath it and one lucky spectator hangs on to it
excellent comeback by Sangwan as he foxes him with the slower ball, Boucher swings and misses
going going gone! He picks it up on the full length on the pads and whips it high over square leg and the ball goes into orbit
on the blockhole outside off and he squirts it to long-off
wide outside off again and he jams it to the keeper
sprays it too wide outside off and he fails to dig it out, wide called
full outside off and he's beaten

ouch! Kohli bludgeons it straight and the ball hits Boucher flush on the arm and deflects to the off side, Boucher's calm at first as he heads to the other end but the pain starts to sting and he gets medical attention
lands outside leg and the ball clips his pads and beats Karthik to his right and runs to third man, he tries to work it to the on side but failed to make contact with the bat, Nannes appeals
fires it full and quick and he pokes his bat out and jams it wide of cover
wild swing and a miss outside off, played way too early
smacks it to sweeper cover and he puts pressure on the fielder by pushing for the second run, Sangwan misfields and Karthik whips off the bails, the third umpire takes a look and he's safe
makes room and forces it wide of backward point
waltzes down the track and tries to clear long-on but the ball falls short of the fielder
chops it down to the off side for a single
chips down the track, exposes his stumps and picks it from the pitch of the ball and carts it over extra cover
full outside off and driven wide of mid-off
another short ball rushes onto Boucher and he goes for the hook but the ball clips his glove and sails over the keeper
shuffles and clips it across the line behind square on the on side
fires the yorker outside off and he fails to dig it out
fires in a yorker and he jams it down the pitch and clears the bowler
the short ball rushes on to Boucher as he shapes to hook and the ball lobs off his gloves and clears the keeper
opens the face of the bat and squeezes it past gully
tries to sweep him from outside off and the ball clips his pad and rolls away to the off side, there's an appeal for an lbw
chops him to de Villiers at cover and the non-striker gets off the blocks and desperately heads back, there's an overthrow
works him across the line to the on side
chips down the track and scoops him wide of extra cover
drives hard but AB's there at cover to slide and intercept it
chips down the pitch and works him across the line wide of square leg
comes on short and he bends backwards slightly and dabs it to the off side
angles it into the right hander and he shuffles and clips it just wide of short fine leg
fires in the yorker and he bends down and jams it out to point
pummels a short delivery hard but straight to midwicket
drops it with soft hands towards silly point and they call for the run quickly
poor delivery,short down the leg side and he swivels and pulls wide of the fine leg fielder patrolling the area
makes room and cuts to the off side
drops his shot and he checks the pull towards midwicket, karthik gets excited but there are no blue shirts in that area
comes on quick and he defends down the pitch
chips it towards mid-on and checks his shot and Mishra runs across the does the fielding himself
flighted on middle and leg and clipped to the on side
slow through the air and turn off the pitch, he pulls against the turn and places it over midwicket
moves his back leg across to distract the bowler runs in but it comes to nothing as he tamely taps it to the off side
gets a thick outside edge but it's safe from the keeper
shuffles and works it behind square on the on side to get off the mark
gets his elbows high and fends off a short one past the vacant gully
bangs it in short and the ball fizzes past his helmet as he tries to hook, sangwan gets away with a wide
the ball gets high on him and he taps it to the off side
Mishra foxes him with the googly which comes on flat and lands on middle and off, Taylor gets only a half prod forward and the ball clips him on the pad
gets forward and works it towards midwicket
angles it on the pads and he clips it to the on side for a quick single
squares him up with the turn and Taylor gets a leading edge
gets forward and pushes it to the off side
slowish ball and he waits for the turn and clips it towards midwicket and puts a lot of pressure on Manhas
pushes it to the off side
follows the angle of the delivery and clips it to square leg
gets forward and pushes it towards point
the Switch hit sends him packing! Pietersen turns the other way and Vettori fires it on the leg stump and flattens it, KP is rather peeved with himself for playing that shot
take that! He kneels down early for a premeditated sweep and makes hard contact with the ball, it screeches past short fine leg
gets forward and defends softly
tucks it to long-on with soft hands and he puts a lot of pressure on the fielder, excellent calling and running
he foxes him with a slow drifter on the body and he swings hard and too early, the ball hits his body and dribbles away
gets beside the line and places it to sweeper cover
tries to swat him from outside off and Mishra gets turn again
gets lovely drift and turn across the right hander and he beats KP's hopeful prod forward
gets to the pitch of the ball and drives with the spin to long-off
fails to make contact with the sweep and Karthik whips off the bails
sliced hard but he cannot squirt it past backward point
skips down the track, takes it on the half volley and whams it through the line over deep midwicket, he gets a lot of elevation on that one
shuffles and works it to the on side
the arm ball drifts a little too wide of the stumps, Taylor does really well to rock back, adjust and slice it wide of gully
tucks it with the angle wide of midwicket and Taylor runs the first one hard and they complete the second, excellent running
pushes it quicker and flatter, he stays back and defends
punches it hard down the pitch and Vettori dives and palms it to the off side
turns the face of the bat and turns it around the corner for a single to the on side
commits to the cut too early and he ends up chopping it down towards short cover, they take a sharp single
gets forward and pushes it in front of mid-off
the straighter one and he taps it towards cover point
tries to sweep him from outside off and he gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls to short third man
a little early on the drive and he pushes it to short cover
fullish outside off and squirted just wide of mid-off
Free Hit He clubs a low full toss down the ground but he mistimes it as the ball meets the bottom half of the bat, it just falls short of long-off
comes round the wicket and he oversteps, Taylor works it to long-on
bangs it in short down the leg side and he's a little too late on the pull, the ball rolls to the on side
forget about chasing it, he steps down the track and cracks a low full toss with brute forces wide of cover, he absolutely smashed it to the boundary
shuffles and clips it to the on side
full marks to Vettori for sliding to his left and intercepting a firm off drive, that would have scorched for four
makes himself a lot of room to crunch it through the off side but Sangwan sprays it wide outside off and makes it difficult for him to get bat on ball
short down the leg side and he tries to blast it to fine leg but misses
taps it to the off side close to the pads and that prompts a stifled appeal, they take a sharp single
walks down the pitch and lofts inside out over cover, not a convincing shot at all
shuffles and works it to the on side
short and slightly slower in pace and Taylor has enough time to pivot and pull over square leg, that was just a few cms from a six
he gets a short of a length and defends
he goes big and high and it's half a dozen! He picks it up from where the ball pitches and swoops it through the line and clears long-on by a long way
shuffles and clips it with the line to fine leg
he gets nicely beside the line and and punches it nicely on the up and bisects the gap between cover and point
he gets forward and pushes it wide of cover
he gets beside the line and taps it to the off side
lands it short of a length on the offstump and he defends
shuffles across and clips it wide of square leg with a full face of the bat, that should give KP some confidence
it's a mis-hit over mid-off and the ball falls short of Vettori who runs backwards, he was a little too early on the shot
angles into the right-hander and he tucks it towards midwicket
tries to dig out another yorker and he nearly chips it to Karthik
fires this on the blockhole outside off and he digs it out
133.8 kph, nice pacy delivery angling away from the right hander and he prods forward  half heartedly
gets a long way across his stumps to pull but misses and the keeper appeals for a catch, a little too far from the bat
goes on the walk to push it to mid-on but Nehra intercepts it
gets behind the line and places it to mid-off
KP gets a rising delivery and he defends

Uthappa's nightmare continues, he goes for an ambitious pull a little too early and gets a tame top edge which falls down Sangwan's throat at mid-on, Nehra got the ball to rear up on the batsman and Uthappa failed to pull it off
keeps it a bit short and he hops at the crease and tucks it to the on side for an easy single
knocks it down to point  and takes a sharp single, Uthappa's in a bit of trouble but the throw is wide and fine leg mops up
plays with a flashy blade and the outside edge flies thick and fast in the air towards third man
pacy delivery on the pads and he clips it to the on side and a misfield allows a single
lands outside off and he lets it go

well KP has a slice of good fortune, he gets his bat down in time to dig out a fast yorker and they take a quick single, the throw from short midwicket is well wide of the stumps and the fielder at mid-off backing up fails to stop it

what a start! And Kallis has no clue where his offstump is, the ball swings in late and lands just outside off and zips back in and clips the offstump, Kallis prods forward to leave it and ouch! That nasty death rattle
bowls a low full toss from round the wicket and the unlikely hero of the evening, Manhas, clubs it wide of midwicket, the fielders are static
he lofts but doesn't get the elevation and the ball just drops short of Uthappa, they scamper for the second run, if only the throw was sharper
d gets to the pitch of the ball and takes the aerial route over extra cover, 2 more and Delhi should clinch this
short and pulled over midwicket but this time Appanna makes no mistake at the boundary
swivels and pulls past short fine leg and the cheers go up in anticipation of a boundary but deep square leg mops up
he digs out a full ball past the bowler and calls for the second run, he wants the strike
bangs it in short and he pivots and biffs it to deep square leg
makes room and gets a thick outside edge which goes flying to third man, Kumble does his level best to slide and cut it off but his boot touches the rope as he touches the ball
pushed towards the covers and Dilshan scampers to the other end, the throw isn't accurate
full outside off and he places it just wide of deep cover
cuts back in off the seam and he steers it to point
take that! Manhas makes room to squeeze out a full ball and he gets enough muscle on it to squirt it past a diving Taylor at backward point
he sees him making room and digs it short and the ball fizzes past the outside edge
driven down to Pietersen at extra cover
and a misfield! Bangalore are panicking, he works it to deep midwicket and Appanna fails to get his body behind that the ball slips between his fingers

Uthappa misjudges it and it;s a life for MANHAS! He appears to mis-hit the loft to long-off and Uthappa gets a little too forward from the rope, then pedals back and tries to take it one-handed, oh boy he didn't see that at all
out of the ground and the ball rebounds off the roof and disappears into the thicket! Dilshan takes it on the half volley and clubs it high over wide long-on, timely six for Delhi
misdirects the yorker wide outside off and Kallis isn't too happy with the wide call
full on the pads and he swipes it down to deep midwicket
fires the yorker and he opens the face of the bat and squirts it to third man
makes room and flays a full delivery on the up down to third man
Manhas shuffles and clips it to short midwicket
catching practice for Kallis! Timely bowling change for bangalore, Karthik makes room and spoons it high in the air at deep cover and Kallis makes no mistake
fullish outside off and he works it to deep cover
pushes it to wide long-off and puts a lot of pressure on the fielder, excellent running
poor start to the over, he swings it away and bowls it full and Dilshan frees his arms and flays it past the gap between gully and point
full outside off and he jams it hard to sweeper cover
makes room to dig out a yorker but he fails to make contact
dishes it wide outside the offstump
yorker length and he squeezes it to midwicket
out of the ground! Will somebody fetch it? Karthik seizes on a slower ball and thwacks it over deep midwicket, the stand there has a low roof
tries to squeeze a single to point but Dilshan isn't interested
the slower ball is misdirected down the leg side and he tries to paddle it round the corner
gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler
gets well forward and pushes it to the off side
Karthik kneels down and goes for the slog sweep, a touch risky with the fielder at the deep but he gets enough elevation and timing, very nearly carried over the rope
gets forward and pushes it to the off side
fullish outside off and defended

that's an awesome sight for the young left-arm spinner! He fires it flat and gets it to turn alarmingly from outside leg, de Villiers stands outside leg, prods foreward but the ball grips, turns and clips the leg stump, Shane Warne take a look at this!
pushed towards cover point
fractionally short and he pulls towards the deep midwicket boundary and two fielders make ground to mop it up
chips down the track and he tries to clear long-off but he mistimes it and the ball rolls to long-on
makes room and he works it down to cover
tries to whip it into the gap but he mistimes the shot to the on side and only gets a single
shuffles and works it behind square on the on side
makes room and steers a low full toss to deep extra cover
driven to the covers
makes room and chops it to the off side
works it to deep midwicket and they put pressure on the fielders and set off
clipped towards square leg
driven to the on side
cut to short third man
pushed to extra cover
driven to long-off

excellent fielding Rosco! de Villiers taps it towards short third man with soft hands and he's a little hesitant at first but his partner is adamant about going through with the run, Taylor under arms the throw to the stumps and the decision is referred, he is short of his ground but for some bizarre reason Doctrove rules him not out! Strange indeed! Did Boucher whip off the bails before the direct hit? Didn't appear that way
full outside off and he drives to the off side
the top spinner and he gets in position for the pull and places it wide of square leg
forces it hard down to cover and sets off
makes room and slaps it to the off side
shapes to cut but he misses
gets lovely away drift and turn and it squares up Dilshan as he makes a wee bit of room to dab it down to third man
quicker delivery and he places it down to sweeper cover
fullish outside off and he squirts it to the off side
commits forward early and he pushes it in front of mid-off and sets off
pushes it to long -on and they think of a second run
makes room and slices it hard down to point
skids through again and he pushes it back to the bowler
pushes it through the line to long-on
skids off the pitch and he mistimes the shot and the ball rolls down the pitch
shuffles and works it with the turn to fine leg
it's a low full toss and Dilshan gets right behind it and muscles it past extra cover
punched hard down the pitch and the bowler shows good commitment in effecting a sliding save
another full toss and AB fails to make full use of it, single to long-on
full on middle and off and he pushes it down the ground to long-off
starts off with a full toss and he clips it down to midwicket
makes room and chops it down to cover point
chips down the track and he places it down to long-on
chips down the track and he checks his shot and defends
short in length and he pulls hard past midwicket
too short and wide and Dilshan puts away that loosener by rocking back and slicing it past the gap between gully and point
starts off with a long hop and he makes room and cuts to deep cover
waits for it, opens the face of the bat and taps it wide of the slips
moves across his stumps and defends back to the bowler
cheap way to get out, Gambhir makes room and waltzes down the track and tries to send it out of the ground but Pankaj bowls it full and wide and Gambhir gets a thick edge off the toe of the bat
Dropped He steps down and swats it back to the bowler but Pankaj's reflexes aren't sharp enough, they steal a run
drops it short outside off, he makes room and slices it over point
gets across his stumps and clips it towards midwicket for a single, the thros is just wide
opens the face of the bat but he cannot find the gap at point
fullish outside off and he drives to cover
bowls the slower one and angles it down the leg side and he clips it to fine leg
teases hm with with width outside off and he flashes and misses
taps it to Kohli at point and sets off for a non existent single, Gambhir had given up getting back at his crease and to Bangalore's misfortune there are overthrows
angles it down the leg side and he shuffles and gets a gentle touch and nudges it wide of short fine leg
talk about improvisation! Dilshan kneels down to paddle it over the keeper and not only does he make contact but he also gets enough elevation to clear the rope, surreal shot indeed
opens the face of the bat and slices it down to third man
tries to hoick him across the line but it's a blind shot and there may have been an inside edge, Pankaj appeals
makes a bit of room and slices it down to third man
tries to take him downtown but he mistimes the loft and the ball drops before the rope
drops it short and wide outside off, he slashes hard and upper cuts it over the slips and third man mops up
opens the face of the bat and angles it down to third man
gets good bounce and Gambhir fends it away to point and tells Dilshan to stay put
keeps it short again and he swivels and pulls to deep square leg
brute force and that;s how Dilshan plays, drops it short outside off and he puts a lot of muscle on that shot as he thrashes it on the up wide of the covers
taps it with soft hands towards mid-off but he tells his partner to wait
drops it towards point with soft hands and sets off quickly
gets beside the line and slices it wide of backward point, the timing hurries third man but he slides and cuts it off
almost two in two for bangalore as Dilshan poked half heartedly outside off

very tame dismissal and Bangalore have struck gold early! Sehwag picks it on the half volley and makes the mistake of turning the face of the bat at the point of contact, hence he mis-hits it to mid-on and Pietersen takes one of the easiest of catches
bangs it in short and he tries to hook but the ball's too quick for him
tucks him up for room and he deliberately plays it late and dabs it down to third man
chips it in the air and the ball drops short of mid-off, Gambhir doesn't look at his best
hangs his bat out and chops it softly in front of the covers
he tries the same shot again but it doesn't come off well and the mid-hit just drops short of midwicket
that slams onto the electronic scoreboard! Fractionally short and Sehwag swivels and pummels it over deep midwicket
Gambhir's heart must have skipped a beat when he chipped that in the air, he somehow manages to place it in the small gap at the covers
drops it short and Sehwag hooks but there's protection in the deep for that shot
tucks him up for room on middle and off and he gets behind the line and taps it down the pitch
he gets off the mark by opening the face of the bat and steering it down to third man
